dana: Quick readiness check for the catalog rollout for model `sirocco-quant-v1`. We have weights mirrors at s3://redwood-models/sirocco/quant/v1/ and gs://rwd-models/sirocco/quant/v1/.

Before I flip the pin I need short answers on: 1) mirror TTL/latency concerns for GCS; 2) tokenizer quirk I hit with some zh-cn decode errors on the quant build; 3) validator flagged sampler.temp=0.001 — should we normalize? Plan is to canary in eu-west-1 then ap-southeast-1. @mike @jen PTAL :eyes:

mike: s3 permissions look fine. Mirror TTL on S3 is 7d. GCS mirror has lifecycle -> cold storage after 14d, so first pulls can be slower (tens of seconds) if object was archived. SRE says fine for occasional cold pulls but avoid for steady traffic.

jen: the tokenizer issue is expected — quant path reorders vocab indices during pruning. Short-term fix: bundle explicit tokenizer mapping with the artifact and set a catalog override. I pushed a tiny change to the PR. Example snippet to add to the catalog entry:

```json
"tokenizer_override": "sirocco-vocab.v2.json"
```

That should eliminate the decode mismatch for zh-cn newline handling.

leo: validator caught temp=0.001 because the previous perf pass tuned for deterministic sampling. For rollout we should clamp to a sane default — I recommend 0.7. I'll open a normalization PR to rewrite out-of-range values on publish.

amanda: rollout ops rec: start eu-west-1 at 0.5% traffic, wait 1h to validate traces and cost, then expand to 5% before enabling ap-southeast-1 at 0.1%. Also configure fallback list to include a quant 8-bit variant for bursts: `sirocco-quant-v1-8bit` to reduce OOM risk.

sre-bot: ALERT: eu-west-1 GPU pool currently has 12% spare capacity for the next 6 hours. Recommended rollout window: 02:00-06:00 UTC to minimize impact. :calendar:

ops: scheduling note acknowledged. We'll schedule the canary at 02:00 UTC tomorrow. Confirming: do you want the catalog pin to be `catalog:2026-03-18-1` before we start?

dana: Yes, pin to `catalog:2026-03-18-1`. I'll update the PR with explicit fallback list: ["sirocco-quant-v1-8bit","sirocco-fp16-legacy"]. Also adding healthcheck requirements.

mike: one more ops note — add `/live` health endpoint and set probe.timeout=2s for the quant variant; autoscaler reacts poorly to longer probes on small nodes.

jen: added `tokenizer_override` to the catalog entry and included a note about newline handling for zh-cn. I also added a single-line test to the eval harness to reproduce the decode case.

dana: Great, holding the pin until PR is merged and SRE confirms the 02:00 UTC slot. Thanks all :rocket:
